description: This file defines API routes for dashboard metrics related to employers and job seekers in a job portal application, utilizing FastAPI. It handles retrieving aggregated statistics such as total jobs posted, application counts, and application statuses for both user roles.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] employer_dashboard( current_user: User = Depends(require_any_role(Role.employer, Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns dashboard statistics for employer users, including total jobs posted, applications received, and application statuses.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] job_seeker_dashboard( current_user: User = Depends(require_any_role(Role.job_seeker, Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns dashboard statistics for job seeker users, including total applications, status breakdown, and recent applications.

ctags.name: employer_dashboard
ctags.signature: ( current_user: User = Depends(require_any_role(Role.employer, Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.signature: ( current_user: User = Depends(require_any_role(Role.job_seeker, Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
